Hey Lisa — thanks for the options and the agenda. Tue 10 Mar works on our side in principle, but a quick heads-up: the US switches to DST on Sun, Mar 8 this year while Europe doesn't switch until Mar 29. That will shift our local times relative to CET.

To avoid surprises: when you say 10:00 CET on Tue Mar 10, that will be 05:00 EDT (US East) / 02:00 PDT (US West) for us because we'll already be on Daylight Saving Time after Mar 8. If the team in Madrid means 10:00 local CET, that will actually be early morning for several of our US participants.

If you want substantial participation from our US engineering leads (Soojin and I), can we either:
- move the session to 14:00 CET (which will be a reasonable morning for our US team after the DST shift), or
- confirm a time that maps to 9–11am US EDT so it's convenient for both sides.

Proposed: Tue, 10 Mar 14:00 CET / 09:00 EDT (should be 06:00 PDT) — I realize PDT will still be early for some, but Marissa can cover the West Coast updates.

I'll leave this with Soojin/Marissa to confirm availability and will update the invite once we lock time.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0123
